description: Full state of one MomoSwap NFT drop: phase, supply, curve quote for minting `count` items (fee included, price per item), the post-graduation request price, floor and wind-down refund, graduation target, royalty — and, for `owner` (default: this wallet), the items held, what selling one back would pay now, and the exit that applies in this phase. If the wallet created the drop, its unclaimed proceeds and, after a target graduation, the part of its share still held back (`creatorHeldBack`: released as items mint, forfeited after its deadline). Read-only.

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)

count.description: items to quote a mint for (default 1)

owner.description: wallet or .cook name whose items to list (defaults to your own wallet)

name: get_nft_drop
title: NFT drop detail
